accident_report: Vehicle 1 (V1) is traveling in Lane 2 at a speed of 70 km/h. Vehicle 2 (V2) is ahead of V1 in the same lane, traveling at a slower speed of 50 km/h. Vehicle 3 (V3) is in Lane 3, 10 meters ahead of V1 and traveling at 80 km/h. V1 approaches V2 and decides to overtake it due to V2's slower speed. After checking the left mirror and seeing that Lane 3 seems clear except for V3, V1 signals left and moves into Lane 3. V1 accelerates to 80 km/h to pass V2 but doesn't notice that V3 has started to decelerate due to an obstacle ahead in Lane 3. Focusing on overtaking V2, V1 drifts too far into Lane 3 and gets too close to V3, which has now slowed down to 60 km/h. V1 tries to brake but still makes a sideswipe contact with V3. The result is a sideswipe collision between V1 and V3, causing minor to moderate damage to both vehicles. They need to pull over to the shoulder, temporarily disrupting traffic in Lane 3.
